Director's notes — Harbour Lights, block one

Keep the camera at the family's eye level inside the house; we only go high and wide at the
harbour, where the sea makes them small.

The lighthouse beam is our clock. Every night scene at the harbour should include at least one
pass of the beam, and the sound of the beam motor is not real — use wind instead.

Kamala never cries on camera until the bedroom scene at the end of episode one. Protect that.
No close-ups on her face before it; hold her in medium shots, often from behind.

Dialogue stays sparse. If a line explains a feeling the picture already shows, cut the line.
